models._note: Google Gemini 3.8 Flash (built on 3.7 Flash). Multimodal (text/image/audio/video/PDF in, text out), 1M ctx / 64K out, customizable effort (high/med/low). AAII 59. Knowledge cutoff Mar 2026. deepmind.google model card 2026-09-02.

models.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber
models._note: Policy variant of Gemini 3.8 Flash with MORE PERMISSIVE cyber mitigations (refusal-boundary relaxed), Fairwind-gated to trusted defenders. Same foundational intelligence — not a raw-capability uplift (cf. GPT-5.5-Cyber). Prioritizes vuln fixing over offensive exploitation.
